title: Up/down binary counter

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, SN54192/SN54193/SN74192/SN74193 (bulletin DL-S 7611828, Dec 1972, rev. Oct 1976)

pins.name: LOAD
pins.text: low: QA..QD take A..D, independent of the count pulses

pins.name: CLEAR
pins.text: high forces all outputs low, independent of count and load

pins.name: UP
pins.text: count-up clock; the other count input must be high

pins.name: DOWN
pins.text: count-down clock; the other count input must be high

functions.text: The four counter bits (QA least significant).
Datasheet: the carry output produces a pulse equal in width to the count-up input when an overflow condition exists. Feeds the next counter's UP input.
Datasheet: the borrow output produces a pulse equal in width to the count-down input when the counter underflows. Feeds the next counter's DOWN input.

state.changesOn: rising edge of UP or DOWN
rules: CLEAR high: Q = 0 at once, overrides count and load
LOAD' low (CLEAR low): Q = D,C,B,A at once
UP rising while DOWN high: Q = Q + 1 (mod 16)
DOWN rising while UP high: Q = Q - 1 (mod 16)

stored.name: FA
stored.next: FA = FA XOR ((DOWN AND 1) OR (UP AND 1))
stored.source: 7-306, 7-311, 7-314 (PDF pages 305, 310, 313) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers (function table: CLEAR high clears first, LOAD' low loads; UP rising with DOWN high counts up, DOWN rising with UP high counts down)

stored.name: FB
stored.next: FB = FB XOR ((DOWN AND FA) OR (UP AND NOT FA))
stored.source: 7-306, 7-311, 7-314 (PDF pages 305, 310, 313) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers (function table: CLEAR high clears first, LOAD' low loads; UP rising with DOWN high counts up, DOWN rising with UP high counts down)

stored.name: FC
stored.next: FC = FC XOR ((DOWN AND FA AND FB) OR (UP AND NOT FA AND NOT FB))
stored.source: 7-306, 7-311, 7-314 (PDF pages 305, 310, 313) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers (function table: CLEAR high clears first, LOAD' low loads; UP rising with DOWN high counts up, DOWN rising with UP high counts down)

stored.name: FD
stored.next: FD = FD XOR ((DOWN AND FA AND FB AND FC) OR (UP AND NOT FA AND NOT FB AND NOT FC))
stored.source: 7-306, 7-311, 7-314 (PDF pages 305, 310, 313) - TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers (function table: CLEAR high clears first, LOAD' low loads; UP rising with DOWN high counts up, DOWN rising with UP high counts down)
